{\scriptsize\raggedright
\textit{Population:} BASE / FINAL[v]. \textit{Unit:} artifact.
\textit{CI:} 95\% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full\_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted); 2 interval(s) rest on fewer usable replicates (resamples with a zero denominator skipped and counted in the estimate note; at least 1,939 used); 1 interval(s) of zero width marked \dag{}.
F01 only = artifacts DIRTY under the frozen rule (findings of any entry state) but not under X02 (only COMPLETED / PARTIAL entries count): X02 DIRTY = F01 DIRTY - F01 only (checked); X04 denominator = the artifacts failing Q06 of the same population (Q06 denominator - pass, checked); the DIRTY composition per tool is T12b, X05 is T12c.
POST-FREEZE (study\_analysis\_001.addendum\_1, DECLARED\_AFTER\_DRY\_RUN, declared 2026-10-17; descriptive, not part of the frozen methodology): X02 three\_state\_tool\_verdict\_reading - post-freeze sensitivity of the F01 rule conflict documented in normalize.py (170 artifacts in the dry run, all build\_failed, clang\_tidy NOT\_ANALYZED entries); X04 statically\_clean\_but\_incorrect - post-freeze descriptive (the frozen methodology named the goal but defined no metric).
BL01: Includes dense\_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10.
IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test\_feedback and combined\_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped\_tests\_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static\_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test\_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction.
IC4: DIRTY means at least one finding the frozen tool configuration marks blocking (dominated by clang-tidy bugprone heuristics, see X03), not a confirmed defect; under the frozen rule findings of entries in analysis-gap states count (sensitivity X02).
IC6: static\_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static\_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.
\textit{Definitions} (methodology and addendum; full text in the JSON form of this table): BASE; FINAL; F01 static\_verdict\_three\_state; X02 three\_state\_tool\_verdict\_reading; X04 statically\_clean\_but\_incorrect.\par
\textsuperscript{a}~pilot: pilot\_002 / Pilotexperiment (12 benchmarks x 3 execution models x 11 models, 1 sample per prompt); pilot block has 12 clusters: percentile intervals are approximate; flagged in every pilot table\par
\textsuperscript{\dag}~Degenerate percentile interval (zero width): every supporting cluster has the same value (a share at 0\% or 100\%, or a difference of 0); the bootstrap cannot express the sampling uncertainty.\par
